launches.title: KugelAudio: A multilingual voice AI model you can run in your own cluster.
launches.tagline: Human-like TTS for 30+ languages, on-prem and low latency
launches.body:
### TL;DR: KugelAudio is a multilingual voice AI model that generates natural speech in 30+ languages and can run fully on-prem in your own Kubernetes cluster.

### <https://youtu.be/R4HqJ8Ai-z4>

**Launch Day Special 🚀**\
Book a demo and mention our launch: we’ll give you **20% off.** \
\
\
**Problem**

Current TTS models are English-first and cloud-hosted. Kugel speaks 30+ languages and dialects natively like Bavarian German, Northern Irish English, or Yemeni Arabic even on edge cases like email addresses, phone numbers, or product names. \
\
**Solution**\
Drop our model into your Kubernetes cluster and use voice AI on patient records, financial transactions, or internal customer data without sending anything to a third party.

**A few more things**

* **60ms latency.** One of the fastest TTS models on the market.
* **IPA notation support** across 30+ languages.
* **Voice cloning** from a few seconds of audio.

### 

**Meet the team**

We’re a team of two from Germany and Poland.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102000&key=user_uploads/2385896/be66da7a-d0de-4690-91d1-1a368e5d0689)

Kajo spent the last 2 years researching TTS at Hasso-Plattner-Institut and built the model. Viktor runs commercial and brings the enterprise sales experience. We kept hearing the same thing from enterprise voice buyers: providers mispronounce their product names and their legal team won't sign the DPA anyway. So we built the thing they actually wanted.\
\
**🤝 Our Ask**

If you deal with mispronunciations or sensitive voice data:

\- Book a [demo](https://calendar.app.google/TESsGfQBZzABugb56)\
\
**Thank you! 🙏**

Kajo and Viktor
